Further natural tissue detail and complete movement/feeding mechanisms remain unfinished.

individual.name: Aurelia aurita
individual.priorFindings: Source bell and oral arms almost invisible; source body oblique to inspection axes.
individual.changes: Retained n- creator tissue meshes, UVs, skeleton, weights, image bytes and animation. One rigid axis alignment and separately disclosed opacity/roughness changes expose the bell and four folded oral arms.
individual.residual: The artist selected form has short splayed arms and simplified tissue, canals and gonadal shapes. False-colour aquarium photography does not fit natural pigment or a particular life stage.

finalInspection.scope: Nine actual compiled main-viewer states and whole retained real reference; final software renderer, not final WebGL optics
finalInspection.findings: Bell, four oral tissues, branched tracks and gonadal loops are now visible and aligned with the axes. The retained artist has a flattened dome, short splayed arms and coarse edge facets; it does not fit the photographed longer-armed individuals. The source clip changes the retained surfaces and stops; not a measured pulse/propulsion controller.
